title: Wins and Losses Album Cover
coreRelationships: The red border strongly frames and contains the chaotic photographic collage.
The numerous photographs are tightly packed and overlap, creating a sense of density and narrative.
The text elements 'WINS AND LOSSES' and 'PARENTAL ADVISORY' stand out against the busy background due to their solid color and clear typography.
The varied angles and sizes of the photographs create a dynamic, non-linear visual flow.
The overall composition is a juxtaposition of personal moments, material wealth, and somber scenes.
reuseFormula: Generate a square canvas. Apply a thick, solid red border. Fill the interior with a dense, overlapping collage of varied photographs, ensuring a mix of themes (luxury, personal, somber) and orientations. Overlay 'WINS AND LOSSES' in white, bold, condensed sans-serif on a red rectangle, centered. Overlay 'PARENTAL ADVISORY EXPLICIT CONTENT' in white sans-serif on a black rectangle, bottom-left.
